returnToPrimaryReference: Return to the primary agent reference
modelAdminOnly: Only administrators can change the model and reasoning effort.
agentSettingsRemembered: Saved on this agent: {{sandbox}} · {{approval}}. Used for future requests, subject to project protections.
agentSettingsSaveFailed: Unable to save this agent’s settings. Review the saved values and explicitly try again.
agentSettingsLoadFailed: Unable to read this agent’s saved settings. Retry before sending a request.
agentCacheSaveError: Unable to save fast navigation. Your previous choice is kept; try again.
agentCacheActiveHelp: This project keeps up to 5 recent agent views in this tab, with live updates. One project at a time; no history is stored on disk.
gitCreateRemotePrHelp: Creates a pull request from this branch already published on GitHub, regardless of which tool published it. No local copy or new push is required. No merge or deployment is performed.
gitRemotePrStale: The remote branch changed. Refresh the list and reopen this dialog before creating the pull request.
gitRetrieveHelp: Downloads commits and creates a new local branch with the same name. No existing branch will be overwritten. Your files and pending changes are preserved without switching the active branch or changing upstream configuration. If the remote revision changed, refresh before confirming again.
gitRetrieveNeedsCopy: Prepare a local working copy for this repository first.
gitRetrieveUnavailable: A writable local copy and connection are required.
systemWorkspaceError: Cannot browse the system space. Check your permissions and its availability.
gitLocalDeleteHelp: Delete only this local branch? Its commits must already be included in the current branch. A branch checked out in this copy or another worktree cannot be deleted. No files or remote branches will be removed. No force deletion.
gitLocalDeleteActive: Cannot delete a branch checked out in this copy or another worktree. Switch to another branch first.
gitLocalDeleteUnmerged: Deletion refused: this branch contains commits absent from the current branch. Merge it first.
gitCreatePrHelp: Opens a pull request on GitHub for this published branch. No merge or deployment is performed. Future commits pushed to this branch will also update this pull request.
gitPrCreated: Pull request #{{number}} created — open on GitHub
gitPrExisting: Pull request #{{number}} already open — open on GitHub
gitPrPushRequired: Push the current version of this branch before creating the pull request.
gitPrSameBranch: The target branch must differ from the published branch.
gitPrCreateFailed: GitHub refused creation. Check token permissions, the branches and whether there are changes to merge before retrying.
gitPrBranchesFailed: Unable to load target branches. Check the GitHub connection and reopen this dialog.
gitLocalCleanRequired: Commit your changes before switching or merging branches.
gitLocalActionHelp: Local operation only, without publishing. The copy must be clean and agents idle. No force or automatic stash. Conflicting merges are rejected without changing files.
gitLocalConflict: Automatic merge unavailable (conflict, incompatible history or unsupported Git). No files were changed.
gitLocalCustomDriver: Custom merge drivers are not allowed for this operation.
gitRefreshAllHelp: Refresh local, GitHub and synchronization data without fetching, pulling or changing files.
gitRemoteReadOnlyHelp: Remote file from GitHub at the displayed revision. Editing and saving are unavailable; local files remain unchanged.
gitCreateBranchHelp: Creates a branch in this local copy only. Nothing is published to or fetched from GitHub.
gitBranchSwitchHelp: Switching is refused when files are modified or an agent is working. Remote references listed here are already known locally.
gitBranchCreated: Local branch “{{name}}” created. The active branch is unchanged.
gitBranchExists: A local branch already has this name. It was not modified.
gitBranchDirty: Commit your changes before switching, or create the branch without switching.
gitNoAgentCopy: No local copy for this agent
gitRemoteGraphHelp: Remote GitHub history, without a local copy or Git fetch. Up to 8 branches and 100 commits; dashed lines indicate parents outside the view. Local references are not modified.
gitRemoteFilesHelp: Read-only on GitHub. Navigation stays at the displayed revision. Refresh returns to the root at the latest revision without changing local files.
gitRemoteEmpty: This repository or folder is empty.
gitRemoteNoPreview: Preview unavailable: binary file, symbolic link, or file larger than 128 KiB.
gitStageReviewHelp: Review the content to prepare. This does not commit or send anything to GitHub. Preparation is rejected if a file changes meanwhile. External Git filters are not executed.
gitStageError: Cannot prepare changes: refresh and review the files again. An active agent, concurrent edit, conflict or unsupported file may block the operation.
gitStageDeletion: This file deletion will be recorded in the next commit.
gitStageBinary: Binary file: the entire content will be prepared without a text preview.
gitStageTruncated: Preview limited to the first 64 KiB; the entire file will be prepared.
gitAgentCopyExists: This agent already has a local copy. To choose another, first select the managed local space and release the current copy’s reservation.
gitCopyOwnedByAgent: Copy reserved for this work agent
gitCopyOwnedElsewhere: Copy reserved for another agent — browsing only
gitCopyUnassigned: Unassigned copy — use it for this agent to reserve it.
gitCopyReleaseActive: To release this copy, first select the managed local space as the working directory.
gitCopyReleaseHelp: The copy, commits and local changes will be preserved. It will no longer be reserved for this agent and can be assigned to another. No files or GitHub repository will be deleted.
gitCopyReleaseError: Cannot release this copy: ensure no agent is using it and no operation is running.
gitGraphHelp: Local copy history, local branches and already known remote refs (☁). Lines link commits to their parents, including merges. Select a commit for details. No automatic fetch or branch switch.
gitGraphLimited: History is limited to the latest 100 commits. Dashed lines indicate a parent outside this preview.
gitPushWriteAccessDenied: GitHub refuses write access to this repository (forbidden). Check that the token selects this repository and grants Contents read and write access, along with any GitHub restrictions. No force push was performed.
gitConnectionEditHelp: Change the name or replace credentials for this connection. The remote repository, connection permissions and local copies remain unchanged. The address is kept to avoid sending a token to another destination.
gitConnectionSecretPresent: Credentials are already stored. They are never displayed.
gitConnectionSecretAbsent: No credentials are stored for this connection.
gitConnectionTokenHelp: Leave blank to keep existing credentials. For GitHub, use a token limited to this repository with Contents read and write access. A new token replaces stored credentials; nothing is sent until you save.
gitConnectionHttpsOnly: Replacing credentials with a token is available only for HTTPS Git connections. Existing credentials will be preserved.
gitConnectionSaved: Connection saved. You can now test it or resume publication.
gitConnectionSaveFailed: Unable to save the connection. Check your permissions and retry. The token field was cleared for security; enter it again if needed.
gitPushAuthRequired: GitHub authentication or write access was refused. Configure a token with repository contents write access for this connection. Credentials are never taken from the agent session.
gitPushRejected: The remote rejected publication: check new commits and branch protections. No force push was performed.
gitPushNetworkUnavailable: The server cannot reach the remote repository. Check the network and proxy before retrying.
gitPushTlsError: The remote certificate cannot be verified. TLS verification remains enabled.
gitCopyDeleteHelp: Only this local copy will be removed from the project. Its files, changes and local commits will be preserved in a recoverable local trash folder. The remote repository, its branches and other copies remain unchanged. A copy used by an agent or another resource cannot be removed: change its working directory first.
gitCopyInUse: Copy in use: first select another working directory for the affected agents or resources.
gitCopyDeleteFailed: Could not remove this copy. Refresh the list and check that it is available and not in use.
gitRemoteReadHelp: Data read from GitHub. This view changes neither local files nor the agent’s working directory.
gitKnownTracking: ↑ {{ahead}} · ↓ {{behind}} against {{upstream}}. Unsynchronized local references; local inspection at {{date}}.
gitNoTrackingComparison: No reliable remote comparison: no upstream or local state unavailable.
gitRefreshRemoteHelp: Refreshes GitHub only, without fetch, pull or local changes.
gitIntegrateHelp: Retrieves the selected GitHub branch and integrates its commits into the displayed local branch. The copy must have no pending changes. A merge may create a local commit; conflicts preserve your local files. Nothing is pushed to GitHub.
gitIntegrateReviewAgain: The copy or remote branch has changed. Close this dialog and reopen it to review the new version.
gitLocalCommitsHelp: Local branch history, including already-published commits. Creating a local commit does not automatically send it to GitHub.
executionLocationUnavailable: This local location is no longer available. Refresh the project locations before selecting it.
localLocationsDescription: The local space managed by Mergeron and other local folders attached to this project. Remote connections are listed separately.
managedLocalDescription: The managed local space is the project’s permanent primary location. Working files are separate from internal data in the .mergeron directory, reserved for the application and hidden by default in the file listing.
systemFilesHidden: Mergeron internal data is hidden in this listing.
systemFilesVisible: Technical view of Mergeron internal data.
systemFilesTechnicalHelp: The .mergeron directory is reserved for the application. This view changes neither your permissions nor existing protections. Project files, including .git and .env, are not hidden by this option.
gitCloneFailed: Could not create the copy. Check repository access and the requested branch.
gitUnbornDiffHelp: Before the first commit, only staged changes are displayed. Unstaged changes are not included.
detachResourceDescription: This only removes the resource connection from the project. The remote repository and all remote and local files will NOT be deleted. Associated working copies will be marked as revoked and will no longer be available to agents; their files will be kept.
gitResourceMissing: This resource is no longer available.
gitDisabledHelp: This connection is disabled. Enable it in the project’s Locations and connections tab.
gitLocalSnapshot: Local snapshot; refresh does not fetch from the remote.
gitNoCopy: The remote is connected. Prepare a working copy to browse and work locally.
gitCopyHelp: Creates an isolated clone. The current agent's workspace and files remain unchanged.
gitInspectionError: Unable to inspect this copy. Refresh or check its availability.
gitInspectionOutputLimit: Git output exceeds the 1 MiB limit. Check untracked files and exclude technical caches (for example .build-cache/) in .gitignore, then refresh.
gitInspectionTimeout: The Git command did not respond within the allowed time. Check disk availability or, for a remote operation, the network, then retry.
gitBrowseError: Unable to open the files in this copy.
gitNoPreparedFiles: No files staged for the next commit.
gitPreparedDiffHelp: Compare the staged version with the last commit. Unstaged edits are not included.
gitBrowseHelp: Browsing does not change the agent’s active working directory.
gitNoSnapshot: Prepare a copy and refresh to inspect Git.
gitBranchesHelp: Local branches in this copy. Published branches are available under GitHub.
gitLimited: Results are limited. Check the full list on your Git provider.
gitChangesHelp: Select a file to compare it. Git actions require explicit confirmation; no automatic deletion.
gitDiffHelp: Changes compared with the current commit (including staged and unstaged changes).
gitDiffError: Unable to load the comparison. Refresh the working copy.
gitUntracked: New file, not yet tracked. Open it to inspect its content.
gitNoTextDiff: No text comparison available (binary file, conflict or metadata-only change).
gitGithubError: Could not load GitHub information. Try again shortly.
gitProviderUnsupported: PRs and checks are currently available for github.com. Files and branches work with other Git hosts.
gitMergeUnknown: Conflict detection in progress or unavailable.
gitNoChecks: No checks reported. This does not mean a merge is approved.
gitMergeHelp: Checks alone do not authorize a merge. GitHub reviews and branch protections still apply. The state is rechecked before merging.
gitActionBusy: Wait until all active agents and Git operations on this server have finished.
gitActionAgentStateUnknown: Unable to verify agent inactivity. Restore the agent service connection before retrying.
gitActionStale: Git changed since your review. Close this window, refresh and review again.
gitActionMergeBlocked: Merge blocked: check status, reviews, conflicts and branch protections on GitHub.
gitActionInProgress: Finish the current merge, rebase or conflict resolution first.
gitActionBranchRequired: Select a named local branch first.
gitActionHttpsRequired: Push from this panel currently requires an HTTPS Git resource without credentials in its URL.
gitActionTokenRequired: Configure a GitHub token with merge permissions for this resource.
gitActionIdentityRequired: Committing requires a signed-in person with a valid name and email in their profile. Have these details completed in People before trying again.
gitAuthorFromSession: The author and email come from the signed-in person. These fields cannot be edited here and will be verified by the server.
gitActionOutcomeUnknown: The connection ended before confirmation. Refresh the PR on GitHub before retrying; it may already be merged.
gitActionFailed: Operation failed or its outcome is unknown. Refresh Git and verify before retrying.
gitActionStagedHelp: Commit includes staged changes only. Prepare them with Git or your agent; unstaged edits are preserved.
gitActionPushHelp: Publish only the reviewed commit to the same branch on the configured remote. No force push, deletion or automatic merge. Uncommitted edits are not published.
gitActionCommitHelp: Review the staged changes below. Only this frozen index will be committed; unstaged files are left untouched. Hooks and signing are not executed by this panel.
gitActionMergeHelp: Creates a merge commit on the PR target branch. Checks and revisions are rechecked on the server. GitHub branch protections apply. The local copy is not updated and no branch is deleted.
gitMergesHelp: The Git merge is already complete. Track its checks and publication here: successful, failed, cancelled, in progress or waiting. Refreshes every 30 seconds.
gitWorkflowUnavailable: Run state unavailable: check GitHub Actions access or connectivity. Success is not confirmed.
gitWorkflowWaitUnknown: GitHub has not confirmed which run or resource is being awaited.
gitWorkflowQueueLimited: Queue position or dependencies incomplete: check GitHub for details.
gitWorkflowLimited: Run list incomplete: overall success is not confirmed.
gitNoMerges: No merges among recently updated closed PRs.
gitMergesLimited: Limited history: up to 5 merges among the 30 recently updated closed PRs.
gitMergeChecksError: Unable to check jobs for this merge. Their success is unconfirmed.
gitRestoreBackupFailed: The recovery branch could not be created. No replacement was started. Check disk space and permissions before reviewing again.
gitRestoreFilesHelp: Restores the selected files and their staged state to the last local commit without changing GitHub. A staged addition absent from that commit will be removed from the copy. A recovery branch is created before any replacement.
gitRestoreGithubHelp: Replaces tracked files, the index and the local branch tip with the selected GitHub branch state. The local branch name stays unchanged. No push. Untracked and ignored files are preserved; a collision blocks the operation.
gitRestoreLocalCommits: Local commits absent from the target, kept in recovery: {{count}}
gitRestoreWarning: The affected changes will be replaced, including their staged state. A local mergeron-backup/… branch preserves previous commits, changed files and the index. No untracked files are cleaned. Do not proceed while another tool is modifying this copy.
gitRestoreAcknowledge: I confirm replacing this local state with the displayed version.
gitRestoreDone: Local state restored. GitHub was not changed.
gitRestoreIncomplete: Uncertain outcome: some files may have changed. Do not retry automatically. Refresh and inspect the copy; the recovery branch below is retained.
gitRestoreRecoveryHelp: The recovery branch is visible in Local → Branches. It preserves previous commits and files before replacement; the staged state is kept in its second parent when a recovery commit was necessary. Do not publish it without an explicit request.
gitRestoreUnsafe: This copy contains special files, a partial index or changes too large for safe restoration. Inspect it before continuing.
gitRestoreCollision: An untracked or ignored file would be overwritten. Move it to safety yourself, then review again.
gitRestoreGithubRequired: This action requires a configured GitHub connection.
explorerNoAgentCopy: No local source copy is available for this agent. Select a source above, then choose “Prepare a working copy” in its menu.
explorerSelectSource: Select a source above to browse its local copy or remote repository.
explorerNoSource: No source is connected to this project. Add a Git connection in the project settings, then prepare a working copy for this agent.
gitPrAssignDescription: PR #{{number}} · Choose an agent from this project. Assignment does not start the agent.
gitPrAgentsEmpty: No agents available in this project.
gitPrAssignError: Could not assign the agent. Check your permissions and refresh the PR list.
gitGithubTimeout: GitHub did not respond in time. Automatic refresh has slowed down.
gitGithubNetwork: Could not connect to GitHub. Automatic refresh has slowed down.
gitGithubRateLimit: GitHub is temporarily limiting requests. Reads are paused.
gitGithubAuth: GitHub rejected the configured token. Check its credentials.
gitGithubAccess: GitHub resource not found or access not permitted.
gitGithubBusy: GitHub reads are busy. Automatic refresh has slowed down.
gitPrListStale: List retained from {{date}}; state unconfirmed and merging suspended.
launchRecoveryBusy: This request is still running. Wait for confirmation before taking action.
launchRecoveryUncertainSend: The agent exists, but the send outcome is unknown. Open its conversation and check what was received.
launchRecoveryKnownAgent: The agent was created. Finish its association without creating another one.
launchRecoveryUnknownAgent: Creation was not confirmed. Check the list, then select the existing agent to associate.
launchRecoverySelect: Existing agent in the working folder
launchRecoveryInventoryUnavailable: The agent inventory is not up to date yet. Refresh after the engine reconnects.
launchRecoveryChecked: I opened this conversation and checked its state.
launchRecoveryNoReplay: Recovery never resends instructions. After association, continue in the existing conversation. You can also close this request after checking: the agent and its history will be kept.
launchRecoveryConflict: Recovery was not confirmed. Refresh and check that the agent and its destination are still available.
launchRecoveryNeeded: This launch needs checking. Use the recovery panel.
launchRecoveryKeep: Keep agent without finishing the association
taskDeliverableFolderInherited: The task and its subtasks use the deliverable folder.
taskFolderOnly: Without a deliverables manager, only a folder reference is available.
taskReferenceInherited: The work reference is inherited from the main task.
taskAgentFolderPreserved: Agents keep their own folder and history. Incompatible assignments must be removed before changing the reference.
taskAgentAssignmentHelp: An agent may be reused for several subtasks of the same main task, but not another main task while those assignments remain. Assignment sends no instructions and preserves the agent folder and history.
sidebarPreferenceError: Unable to save this display. Try again.
sidebarAssignmentError: Assignment refused or unconfirmed. Refresh and verify the project, main task, deliverable and revision.
sidebarProgressLocked: Reopen this subtask to change its progress.
sidebarProgressError: Unable to save. Refresh the task and check its latest revision before retrying.
sidebarProgressUnavailable: Refresh the context to load this task revision.
gitDeliverablesDescription: Keep documents and their labels in the project agents’ Git copies. The livrable.json files let another installation recognize them.
gitDeliverablesNoBoard: Add a deliverables manager to this project first.
gitDeliverablesRestrictedWarning: Mergeron permissions do not protect files published to Git. Excluding them later does not remove them from repository history.
gitDeliverablesGuarantees: Saving a version triggers an export. Imports require review. No automatic commits or pushes. Explicit Mergeron document deletions are propagated when the Git file is unchanged. Conflicts block synchronization. Disabling preserves files and history.
gitDeliverablesLargeFiles: Files larger than 10 MB require separate Git LFS handling and block this transfer. An LFS pointer without local content is never imported as a document.
gitDeliverablesOperationFailed: Operation interrupted; review changes and retry:
gitDeliverablesSaved: Setting saved. Commits and pushes remain explicit Git actions.
gitDeliverablesNoChanges: No content changes. You can enable or retain this mode.
gitDeliverablesActive: Git deliverables mode is active for this copy.
gitDeliverablesDetected_one: One deliverable recognized in this repository.
gitDeliverablesUnavailable: Unable to inspect Git deliverables. Check the copy and manifests.
gitDeliverablesReasonMetadata: Title, description, names or labels changed.
gitDeliverablesReasonKnownOlderDocument: Older version already retained in Mergeron: export the current version to Git.
gitDeliverablesIncomingReview: Git changes require your review. Nothing is imported into Mergeron automatically.
gitDeliverablesReasonDocument: Content changed; importing creates a Mergeron version.
gitDeliverablesReasonDeletedDocument: Document deleted in Mergeron: remove it from the Git copy, then commit and push when you choose.
gitDeliverablesReasonDeletedDocumentChan: Document deleted in Mergeron but changed in Git: content preserved; resolve the conflict.
gitDeliverablesReasonRemovedInGit: Missing from Git: retained in Mergeron. An explicit decision is required.
gitDeliverablesReasonRemovedInMergeron: Missing from Mergeron: retained in Git. No automatic recreation.
gitDeliverablesReasonMetadataChangedBoth: Organization changed on both sides: reconcile changes before retrying.
gitDeliverablesReasonKnownOlderMetadata: Git organization matches an older synchronized version: update from Mergeron.
gitDeliverablesReasonMetadataBaselineMis: Organization differs without a verified common baseline: manual comparison required, no automatic overwrite.
gitDeliverablesReasonDocumentChangedBoth: Content changed on both sides: choose which content to retain; no automatic overwrite.
gitDeliverablesReasonMissingFile: The manifest references a missing file.
gitDeliverablesReasonLargeFileRequiresLf: Large file: configure LFS handling before this transfer.
gitDeliverablesReasonLfsContentMissing: Git LFS content must be retrieved locally before import.
gitDeliverablesReasonReadOnlyDeliverable: Finalized or archived deliverable: imports are blocked while it remains read-only.
gitDeliverablesReasonUntrackedFileCollis: An unrecognized file occupies this path. It will not be overwritten.
gitDeliverablesAdoptFolders: Also propose converting subdirectories without livrable.json (directly contained files only).
gitDeliverablesReasonIgnoredByGit: The directory or a document is excluded by .gitignore. Correct the rule before synchronizing.
gitDeliverablesAgentCopies: This mode applies to the project. Mergeron retains documents and their versions. Export uses only the agent’s own Git copy when it is ready and writable; imports require review, with no automatic commit or push.
gitDeliverablesMissingAgentCopy: No writable agent Git copy is available. You can save this mode and keep editing deliverables in Mergeron. Export waits for the agent’s own writable, ready copy.
gitDeliverablesAmbiguousBoard: Multiple deliverable managers were detected. Resolve this inconsistency before configuring Git.
gitDeliverablesPending: Export pending · review after a restart
deliverableGitLocalHelp: This status compares Mergeron with the files in the indicated copy and branch. Up to date locally does not mean committed or published to GitHub. Imports and conflicts still require review.
gitDeliverablesRenameFolders: Propose readable folder names for existing deliverables. Moves will be previewed before confirmation; no automatic commit or push.
gitDeliverablesReasonReadableFolder: Move the folder to a readable name, preserving its portable identity and all files.
gitDeliverablesReasonFolderCollision: The destination folder already exists; nothing will be replaced.
deliverableGitStateWaiting: Export waiting: Git is busy with another operation or an active agent
deliverableGitDocumentError: This document cannot synchronize: conflict or error. No automatic overwrite.
deliverableGitDocumentReview: This document needs comparison or approval before import.
deliverableGitDocumentPending: This document is waiting to be exported.
gitDeliverablesPartial: Documents without conflicts were synchronized. The remaining differences are listed below for review; no automatic overwrite.
gitDeliverablesReasonDocumentPathChanged: The document has a different name or path in Mergeron and Git. Review the move before synchronizing.
gitDocumentUnavailable: Comparison unavailable. Check the Git copy and your permissions, then refresh.
gitDocumentEqual: The contents are identical. Updating their reference may be sufficient.
gitDocumentDifferent: The contents differ. Choose which version to keep for this document only.
gitDocumentMissing: This document is absent from the Git copy. You can export the Mergeron version.
gitDocumentProtected: A path, name, permission, index or file-size protection prevents this correction. No forced replacement will be made.
gitDocumentConfirmExport: This correction will replace only this Git file with the Mergeron version. The replaced Git content will be retained in a private recovery copy.
gitDocumentConfirmImport: This correction will import the Git version into this Mergeron document only. A new version will be created; the previous one stays in its history.
gitDocumentChanged: The correction failed or the data changed. Refresh the comparison before trying again.
explorerTabPreferenceUnavailable: The preferred project tab cannot be loaded or saved right now. Navigation remains available.
projectLocationsDescription: Project folders and Git working copies. Each conversation keeps its own active folder.
reuseConnectionLocationHelp: Settings and credentials come from the selected connection. No new access is created.
noRemoteProjectLocation: No remote folder attached. Connections can be used without a location.
connectionOnlyHelp: This connection does not add a project folder.
sshAgentAccessHelp: Allows the agent to use SSH. Commands require read/write access and an explicit request. The allowed file root does not restrict SSH commands.
connectionScopeHelp: The allowed root limits file operations; it does not declare a location.
remoteConnectionEditHelp: Edit the name, agent availability or credentials. The address and attached locations are preserved.
remoteConnectionSecretHelp: Leave secret fields empty to keep credentials. To replace them, supply all required settings, including SSH host fingerprints.
approvalArgumentsMissing: This action’s complete arguments are not available in this card. Its exact effect cannot be confirmed here.
approvalGoalTool: Allow this tool invocation with the arguments below.
approvalGoalGitCommit: Create a local commit from the changes already staged in the index. This does not publish them to the remote repository.
approvalGoalGitStage: Stage the listed files for a future commit.
approvalGoalGitUnstage: Unstage the listed files without discarding their local changes.
approvalGoalGitCreateBranch: Create the named local branch from the requested reference.
approvalGoalGitSwitchBranch: Switch the local Git copy to the named branch.
approvalGoalGitFetch: Fetch the named remote branch into this local Git copy.
approvalGoalGitMerge: Start a local merge with the specified revision. Conflicts may require resolution.
approvalGoalGitContinueMerge: Finish the local merge after conflict resolution using the specified commit message.
approvalGoalGitAbortMerge: Abort the current local merge. Changes made to resolve its conflicts will be lost.
approvalGoalFiles: Allow the file changes shown in this request. Review paths and differences before deciding.
approvalGoalCommand: Run the displayed command with the requested access. Its full text remains available for review.
approvalGoalTerminalInput: Send the specified text to the existing terminal. That program may interpret it as a command.
approvalGoalNetwork: Allow access to the network destination shown in this request.
approvalGoalPermissions: Grant only the accesses selected below, for the indicated scope.
approvalGoalInput: The server requests your response to the form or confirmation below.
approvalGoalCommandMissing: The engine requests command authorization, but did not supply its text to this card. Review the available details before deciding.
approvalGoalGitReview: Review the selected changes before staging them for a commit.
approvalGoalGitRestoreReview: Review a restoration and its consequences before changing files.
approvalGoalGitRestore: Restore files to the requested state. Affected local changes will be lost.
contextProfileScope: Applied to exchanges you request, including shared agents. They change neither project rules nor permissions. Automations use their execution identity.
contextError: Could not complete this operation. Check copy access, the AGENTS.md file and your permissions. For concurrent changes, reload before retrying.
contextSaved: Preferences saved. Effective on the next exchange.
contextIndependent: The instruction source is independent of the working directory. It grants no additional access.
contextGitScope: Root AGENTS.md is read from the local copy, including uncommitted changes. AGENTS.override.md takes precedence when present. The agent requests scoped subdirectory instructions through MCP context as needed.
contextReceiptLimit: “Checked” does not mean “supplied”. “Supplied” confirms runtime delivery or an MCP return, not attentive reading or compliance. After detected compaction, supply must be restored on the next MCP call or exchange.
contextUseSource: Use a copy as instruction source
contextRefreshPolicy: Versions are checked before every new exchange. MCP supplies the content when the agent requests it; the non-MCP path sends it directly. An unavailable associated Git source blocks startup instead of silently allowing stale instructions.
contextProjectSeparation: These shared files are managed by Mergeron. Versioned technical instructions stay in Git; each agent can choose a source in the right sidebar → Sources → repository menu. No files are copied or overwritten between these sources.
